deepseek4_graph_path.finding: DeepSeek4 uses a model-specific graph path that builds separate gate, up, swiglu, down, weight, and sum operations. The generic llm_graph_context::build_moe_ffn fused-up/gate branch is not the final DS4 path to optimize.

generic_fused_up_gate.finding: This path can fuse up/gate into swiglu for eligible decode graphs, but it does not fuse or retain down, and historical DS4 fused-up/gate runs regressed. It cannot by itself implement the top64 sparse up/down pair route.

existing_ds4_hot_dispatch.finding: This is the closest graph-level retained-GPU mechanism, but it allocates dense per-layer K hot experts plus P dummy experts and one padding slot. For the top64 sparse pair profile, this is the rejected 2507.5-3761.25 MiB payload shape rather than the 544 MiB ideal payload.

hard_bound.paper_route: graph-level zero-transfer top64 sparse up/down pair route
hard_bound.implication: Any backend copy, gate recompute, per-layer dummy payload, CPU scatter, or scheduler split overhead above about 19 ms rejects the route.

next_allowed_work.candidate: DS4 graph-level sparse retained hot branch, not one-stream helper and not current DS4_HOT dense per-layer manager.
required_properties: Use the top64 sparse pair profile as global selected pairs, not per-layer K dummies.
Keep gate/up/down hot branch on CUDA tensors or an equivalent retained CUDA buffer through the down result.
Avoid CPU-backend D2H/H2D and CPU scatter in the hot branch.
Avoid current DS4_HOT K+P+1 per-layer allocation shape unless a new hard-bound proves it still fits the 18.947 ms margin.
Prove final hot/cold combination placement and any scheduler copies before any logit-changing benchmark.
minimum_first_probe: Emit graph/backend placement for every DS4 MoE layer under a proposed sparse-hot branch.
Count selected hot payload bytes and dummy/padding bytes separately.
Count all backend copies inserted by the scheduler for hot gate/up/swiglu/down and final hot/cold combine.
Run fixed-text top1 with no logit changes or compare-only output first.
Reject immediately if any hidden backend copy or dense per-layer dummy payload appears.

rejected_continuations: Adding sparse pair logic on top of ggml_cuda_moe_stream_one.
Rerunning generic GGML_MOE_STREAM_FUSED_UP_GATE as a SOTA candidate without solving down and final placement.
Using current DS4_HOT_DISPATCH profile format for top64 sparse pair without a new payload-bound that beats the known dummy inflation.
decision: Proceed only with a graph-level retained sparse-hot design/probe. Do not run a strict cold SOTA benchmark until placement, payload, scheduler-copy count, correctness, RAM, and TTFT gates are proven.
